title: Area of Circle over Square transitioning to Volume of Sphere over Cube
full_prompt:
Write a ManimGL script that visualizes the ratio of the area of a circle to a circumscribed square, and then dynamically transitions this concept into 3D to show the ratio of the volume of a sphere to a circumscribed cube.

First, display a fraction representing Area(Circle) / Area(Square). Instead of text placeholders for the circle and square, embed a small blue Circle and a small red Square directly inside the Tex formula. Below this fraction, write an equals sign, the formula pi * (1)^2 / (2 * 2), and its decimal approximation (~0.785).

Next, transition the scene to 3D. Transform the 2D Circle into a 3D Sphere with a white SurfaceMesh, and transform the 2D Square into a 3D VCube. Simultaneously, transform the text 'Area' into 'Volume' in the fraction. Update the formula below to represent the volume ratio: (4/3) * pi * (1)^3 / (2 * 2 * 2), and display its decimal approximation (~0.524). Ensure smooth transitions using FadeTransform and FadeTransformPieces.

visual_techniques: Embedding Mobjects inside Tex formulas using replace()
Transitioning from 2D shapes to 3D shapes (Sphere, VCube)
Using SurfaceMesh to give depth to 3D spheres
Deactivating depth test for custom layering

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using standard Manim Community Cube instead of VCube or failing to handle 3D camera orientation properly.
common_failure_modes.note: VCube and SurfaceMesh are specific to ManimGL. In ManimCE, standard Cube and Sphere must be used with a 3D camera scene.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect alignment when replacing Tex placeholders with Circle and Square mobjects.
common_failure_modes.note: The replacement must scale and position the shapes precisely where the Tex placeholders were.
